map.柔道比赛技术评分工具，从投技(立技)和寝技(地面技)两个维度评估柔道选手技术水平: A judo competition scoring tool that evaluates a judoka's technical level across throwing (tachi-waza) and grappling (ne-waza) dimensions, factoring in ippon, waza-ari, yuko and other technical scores.
map.一本是最高的技术得分，直接获胜: Ippon is the highest technical score and wins the match outright
map.两个技有合计为一个一本: Two waza-ari combine into one ippon
map.投技(立技)和寝技(地面技)是柔道两大技术体系: Tachi-waza (standing) and ne-waza (ground) are judo's two major technical systems
map.抓握(组手)是柔道技术的起点，至关重要: Grip fighting (kumite) is the starting point of judo technique and is crucial
map.投技与寝技分别打分，对比站立与地面技术均衡性制定补强重点。: Score throwing and grappling separately, then compare standing vs. ground balance to set improvement priorities.
map.一本（10 分）即胜；技有（7 分）、有效（5 分）累计；寝技压制 10 s 计: Ippon (10 points) wins; waza-ari (7) and yuko (5) accumulate; a 10 s ground pin counts as ippon.
map.大幅摔投或压制 20 s（原 25 s）判一本。: A decisive throw or a 20 s pin (formerly 25 s) awards ippon.

map.按比赛得分结构定，站立主导则投技权重高，应依选手风格调整。: Set by the match scoring mix; a standing-dominant judoka gives throwing more weight, so adjust to the athlete's style.
map.柔道技术评分工具从投技、寝技和抓握技术3个维度评估柔道技术水平，结合一本、技有、: The judo technical scoring tool evaluates skill across 3 dimensions — throwing, grappling, and grip technique — and uses ippon, waza-ari, yuko and other match data to compute an overall score and win rate.
map.胜率与一本率统计: Win rate and ippon rate statistics
map.综合评分 = 0.4×技术均值 + 0.3×每场技术得分 + 0.3×胜率（上限: Overall score = 0.4 x technique average + 0.3 x per-match technique score + 0.3 x win rate (capped at 100)
map.技术均值 =（投技×10 + 寝技×10 + 抓握×10）÷3，即投技/寝技/抓: Technique average = (throwing x 10 + grappling x 10 + grip x 10) / 3, so the three dimensions (throwing, grappling, grip) carry equal weight (one third each). Per-match technique score = technique score / total matches x 100, where technique score = ippon x 1 + waza-ari x 0.5 + yuko x 0.2. Win rate = wins / total matches. The three parts are weighted 0.4 / 0.3 / 0.3; the higher the stronger.
